scientific_integrity: The support gap and crossing probabilities were replayed with exact integer/rational arithmetic; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the fixed-grid \(d=2\) martingale, horizon \(N=128\), and level \(0.05\).
No numerical transfer is claimed for Sinkhorn-corrected, mixed, derandomized, or other-prior martingales.
Originality retains residual risk from historical sequential multinomial literature under different terminology.
title: Exact 5% finite-horizon calibration of the four-cell rank martingale
